text: dsh-apify-plugin 将 Apify MCP 服务和技能接入 DSH，可搜索 Actor、查看详情与文档；设置 APIFY_TOKEN 并重启后，还能运行 Actor、读取数据集结果。随包技能覆盖多平台抓取工作流、Actor 创建与改造、输出 schema 生成和应用 SDK 集成。适合在 DSH 中使用网页抓取与自动化工具，或开发 Apify Actor 的用户。无令牌时仅提供发现功能。

dsh-apify-plugin connects Apify MCP and skills to DSH. It searches Actors and retrieves details and docs; with APIFY_TOKEN, it runs Actors and reads datasets. Skills cover scraping workflows, Actor development, schema generation, and SDK integration.
想在 DSH 里搜索能抓取网页数据的工具
有没有办法让 DSH 查找 Apify 上的现成 Actor 并看它们的说明？
我想用 DSH 调用云端抓取 Actor 并取回结果
如何让 DSH 帮我把已有项目包装成可部署的 Apify Actor？
Help me find and run an Apify scraper from DSH, then retrieve its dataset.
I want guidance for building an Apify Actor or adding Apify calls to my app.
dsh-apify-plugin 的功能「Actor 搜索与详情」：通过 Apify MCP 查询 Actor、读取详情及文档；未设置 APIFY_TOKEN 时也提供受限的发现类工具。
dsh-apify-plugin 的功能「运行 Actor 与读取结果」：配置 APIFY_TOKEN 后连接完整 Apify MCP 工具，可运行 Actor 并读取数据集和键值存储结果。
dsh-apify-plugin 的功能「多平台抓取工作流」：提供 apify-ultimate-scraper 技能，指导通过 Apify CLI 组合多个 Actor 完成抓取和资料整理任务。
dsh-apify-plugin 的功能「Actor 开发与集成」：提供创建或改造 Actor、生成输出 schema，以及将 Apify 客户端接入现有应用的技能指南。
dsh-apify-plugin 未设置 APIFY_TOKEN 时仅开放搜索、详情和文档查询；运行 Actor、读取数据集结果需要令牌，并在启动时读取配置。
怎样让 DSH 根据需求挑选合适的网页抓取 Actor？
Can DSH help me design output schemas for an Apify Actor?

dsh-apify-plugin README · Apify plugin for DeepSeek Harness：Search, run, and build [Apify Actors](https://apify.com/store) directly from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-apify-plugin README · What you get：| Component | Name | Purpose | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Skill (entry point) | `apify` | Routes each Apify request to the right skill or tool. | - |
| MCP server | `apify` (`https://mcp.apify.com/`) | Searches Apify Store, fetches Actor details and docs. With a token it also runs Actors and reads their results. | `APIFY_TOKEN` to run Actors |
| Skill | `apify-ultimate-scraper` | Multi-step scraping workflows across 15+ platforms. | Apify CLI |
| Skill | `apify-actor-development` | Creates, tests, and deploys a new Actor. | Apify CLI |
| Skill | `apify-actorization` | Turns an existing project into an Actor. | Apify CLI |
| Skill | `apify-generate-output-schema` | Generates output schemas for an existing Actor from its source code. | - |
| Skill | `apify-sdk-integration` | Adds Actor runs to your own app with the `apify-client` package. | `APIFY_TOKEN` in your app |

dsh-apify-plugin README · What you get：Skills load when a request matches them, or run one directly as `/<skill-name>`. Skills marked "Apify CLI" need the [Apify CLI](https://docs.apify.com/cli) installed and logged in.

dsh-apify-plugin README · Before you start：- **Node.js `^22.23.4 || >=24.22.1`.** On older versions, `dsh` exits without printing anything.
- **pnpm on PATH.** `dsh plugin` forwards to it.
- **An Apify API token** from [Apify Console](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?utm_source=deepseek-harness&utm_medium=integrations) (free accounts work). Without a token only search/inspect tools load. If you already use the logged-in [Apify CLI](https://docs.apify.com/cli), the agent can run Actors through it instead (requires **Full access** sandbox mode).

dsh-apify-plugin README · Install：Plugins are installed per `dsh` profile. Use the profile you run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-apify-plugin
```

Add your token to a `.env` file where you launch dsh:

```bash

dsh-apify-plugin README · .env：APIFY_TOKEN=<your-apify-token>
```

Restart `dsh`. It reads the token once at startup, so a token set during a session has no effect.

dsh-apify-plugin README · Verify：Start a new session and ask:

> List the Apify skills and the `mcp__apify__` tools you can use.

You should see the six skills above. With a token, the tools include `mcp__apify__call-actor`. Without one, you get only `search-actors`, `fetch-actor-details`, `search-apify-docs`, and `fetch-apify-docs`.

dsh-apify-plugin README · Try it：> Use Apify to find a good Actor for scraping Google Maps reviews. Show me its input schema and pricing. Don't run it.

> Use Apify to scrape the top 10 Google search results for "web scraping best practices" and summarize what they have in common.

dsh-apify-plugin README · Configuration：Override either bundle row by `id` from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. See `cordis.patch.yml` in this repo for the full default. To change which tools load, edit the `tools=` query parameter in the MCP URL ([docs](https://docs.apify.com/platform/integrations/mcp), [visual picker](https://mcp.apify.com)).

dsh-apify-plugin README · Troubleshooting：**`invalid_token` on startup.** Token is set but wrong. Fix it and restart.

**The agent says it cannot run an Actor.** You're in discovery-only mode. Set `APIFY_TOKEN` and restart.

dsh-apify-plugin README · Troubleshooting：**npm reports root-owned files and suggests `sudo chown`.** The default **Workspace Write** sandbox blocks writes outside your workspace, including the npm cache in `~/.npm`, and npm reports that as an ownership problem. `sudo chown` doesn't help, so reject any prompt to run it. To get past the error, run the command that failed (such as `apify create` or `npm install`) yourself in the workspace directory and let the agent continue. Approving the agent's escalation or switching to **Full access** also works, but it gives the agent unrestricted access to your whole system, so do that only if you trust the model, or run `dsh` in a container or VM.
dsh-apify-plugin README · Troubleshooting：**The plugin seems out of date or missing.** Check that you installed it into the profile you're running. Each profile has its own copy.

dsh-apify-plugin README · Remove：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-apify-plugin
```

**Note:** Actor runs consume [Apify usage](https://docs.apify.com/platform/console/billing) on top of model provider costs.
